selection: Prioritize the full textbook vocabulary index and remove obvious English lookalikes. Retain useful false friends. Supplement to 2,000 distinct entries.
level: B1 to B2, matching the course; an editorial study shortlist, not an official CEFR list.
sourcesReviewed: Full book vocabulary index, printed pages 308–312; vocabulary headwords on 309–312. Chapter references cover all six chapters. Idioms and receptive-only section are not included as single-word targets.
Supplied 29-page PDF, chapter pages 21–32, including the character vocabulary exercise.
limitations: Book-verified denotes index headwords (prepositions/reflexive markers omitted) or individually verified chapter words. Other entries are supplemental, not claimed as book vocabulary. Source categories are not exhaustive text searches.
application: Approved review applied to the app: 2,000 cards; 883 existing card IDs retained and 1,117 new words added. Retired-card history remains stored but is excluded from current-deck progress counts.
